summary.text: Richard Goldman is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 53, in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is running against incumbent Republican Michael Lemelin.

paragraphs.text: Richard Goldman won the 2024 Democratic primary for Maine House of Representatives District 53, but Ballotpedia lists him among withdrawn or disqualified candidates for the 2024 general election, in which incumbent Michael Lemelin defeated Judith Tunkle.
In 2026 he advanced from the June 9 Democratic primary for the same seat.
